item.title: PromeFTP 1.0.7
item.description:
More reliable terminal triggers and passwords

Send multiline trigger replies, see accurate password save status, and keep your workspace navigation after restarting.

  • Send multiline trigger replies
    Each line is sent with Return. A trailing newline does not add an empty command.
  • Enable or pause trigger rules
    Manage triggers beside Snippets and keep each rule's enabled state across restarts.
  • Know whether a password was saved
    The connection form keeps the entered value and reports success, rejection, a server that did not request it, or a storage failure.
  • Keep sidebar selection and history order
    The selected sidebar tab returns after restart, and connection history remains newest first.
  • Open workspaces without losing sessions
    Restoring a saved workspace keeps currently running sessions open.

Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
